title: Panopticon Agent Enrollment Request (schema_version 1)
description: POST /api/v1/agents/enroll body. Phase 13: proves possession of the endpoint's newly generated ECDSA P-256 private key before panopticon-manager binds public_key to agent_id/host_id. The private key itself never appears on the wire. See docs/CONTRACT.md section 5 and panopticon-manager/docs/adr/004-agent-enrollment-identity.md.

public_key.description: Base64 (RFC 4648, standard alphabet, padded) of the raw 65-byte uncompressed NIST P-256 point: 0x04 || X (32 bytes) || Y (32 bytes). Not DER/SPKI-wrapped -- kept deliberately simple so all three implementations (Python cryptography, Windows CNG, OpenSSL) encode/decode it identically without an ASN.1 dependency.

nonce.description: Base64 of the exact 32 random bytes returned by a prior, still-unexpired, not-yet-consumed POST /api/v1/agents/enrollment-challenge call.

signature.description: Base64 of a DER-encoded ECDSA signature (RFC 3279 / SEC1) over the raw nonce bytes (not the base64 text), produced with the private key matching public_key. This is the enrollment's proof of possession.
